title: Bitter German Cheese Fritters
description: A unique dish combining the bitterness of German beer and the richness of cheese, perfect as a snack or dessert.

ingredients.name: German beer
ingredients.notes: used for marinating and adding flavor

ingredients.name: cheese
ingredients.notes: strong, hard cheese like cheddar or gouda

ingredients.name: bake mix
ingredients.notes: for adding a sweet and crunchy texture

instructions: Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 350°F (180°C).
In a large bowl, combine the grated cheese, chopped wilted lettuce, flour, bake mix, and egg.
Marinate the mixture with the German beer for at least 30 minutes.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into small patties.
Coat the patties with a thin layer of flour.
Fry the fritters in batches until golden brown, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Drain the fritters on paper towels and serve hot.
Optional: serve with a side of sweet chili sauce or a dollop of sour cream.
